question: Should `/workspace` become a supported alias in gateway and CLI runtime containers, or remain reserved as the sandbox-container workspace path?
rationale: Current source and documentation intentionally use different paths for runtime containers and sandboxes, so adding the alias creates a durable filesystem contract that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Support a tested alias
options.body: Add an image-level alias, preserve the canonical home path, document mount-shadowing semantics, and verify packaged Docker and Podman behavior.

options.title: Keep sandbox-only semantics
options.body: Do not add the alias; instead update workspace and container guidance so agents consistently use `/home/node/.openclaw/workspace` outside sandboxes.

recommendation.title: Support a tested alias
recommendation.body: Add an image-level alias, preserve the canonical home path, document mount-shadowing semantics, and verify packaged Docker and Podman behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest combined signal from recent container history and the existing product-boundary discussion on this issue.
